svg.aria-label: Inside fip.bin: a table of contents followed by six images: the OP-TEE header, the OP-TEE pager image, the OP-TEE pageable image, U-Boot, the fw-config device tree and U-Boot's device tree, with their offsets, sizes, fiptool flags, make arguments and the address BL2 loads each one to.
svg.text: Inside fip.bin: six images behind one table of contents
A Firmware Image Package is a ToC (a UUID per image, with offset and size) followed by the images. BL2 asks for each by UUID.
fip.bin = 1,650,422 bytes, drawn to scale (a few images are thinner than one pixel and are drawn 3 px wide)
44-byte header: entry point and sizes of OP-TEE
tee-pager_v2.bin: the resident part, SCMI server inside
tee-pageable_v2.bin: the rest, paged in on demand
BL2's load plan: where each image goes, TZC-400 regions
Secure Payload BL32 (Trusted OS): offset=0x128, size=0x2C, cmdline="--tos-fw"
Secure Payload BL32 Extra1 (Trusted OS Extra1): offset=0x154, size=0x12398
Non-Trusted Firmware BL33: offset=0x6B4EC, size=0x10C3C8, cmdline="--nt-fw"
• OP-TEE is three files here: the pager is on for STM32MP15 (CFG_WITH_PAGER ?= y).
• No BL31 and no DDR firmware: this chip needs neither. BL2 itself is not in the FIP.
• The FIP partition is 4 MiB; this FIP uses about 1.6 MB, U-Boot being the biggest part.
Sizes and offsets are from the build described in docs/10-versions.md. UUIDs and flags: TF-A include/tools_share/firmware_image_package.h and plat/st/stm32mp1/platform.mk.
